question: In Which year did Ernst Haeckel introduced the term ‘ecology’ to describe the economies of living forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1866**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The word ecology was coined in 1866 by the German scientist Ernst Haeckel.**
 
• Ecology is the study of relationship between living organisms like human and their environment.
 
• it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The word ecology is believed to have been invented by Ernst HaecKel (1869) .
 
 
• Its first authentic usage was made by Reiter (1885).
 
 
 
• All the interacting organisms in an area together with the non-living constituents of the environment form an ecosystem.
 
• There are 3 types of ecology:** landscape, behavioral and population ecology. **
 
• The functional unit of the ecological system involves complex actions occurring between its biotic and biotic components.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **term ecology** system was** first used by Ernst Haeckel**
 
• **Dr. Ramdev Mishra **is known as **the father of ecology in India**.
 
• He founded the **International Society for Tropical Ecology in the year 1956.**
